arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Paden argued the foreign sovereign owns the subsidiary.
Mr. Massey argued parent stock does not equal subsidiary stock.
Mr. Minear cited corporate law principles separating the entities.
Justices questioned the consistency of the ownership claim.
